challenges.author: Stack_Watcher
challenges.title: Format String Leak

challenges.description:
Reverse engineer the logic of the following assembly-like function. What string parameter yields the success branch?

```
mov eax, [input_str]
add eax, 4
cmp byte ptr [eax], 'R'
jne fail
cmp byte ptr [eax+1], '3'
jne fail
cmp byte ptr [eax+2], 'v'
jne fail
cmp dword ptr [eax+3], 0x41327830
```
Note: 0x41327830 is ASCII hex representation in Little Endian. Decode it to letters to reveal the full string flag.
hints: 0x41327830 in little endian reads as bytes: 30 ('0'), 78 ('x'), 32 ('2'), 41 ('A').
Combine the decoded sequence with the previous checked characters R, 3, v.
